title: Vibrant Abstract Landscape
description: A colorful surreal landscape painting featuring rolling green and yellow hills, stylized trees with rounded colorful foliage, and a bright winding path. Three horizontal white bars with circular cutouts overlay the center of the composition like a graphic interface element.
prompt: A vibrant surreal landscape with rolling green and yellow hills, stylized trees with rounded colorful foliage in pink, purple, and blue, and a winding yellow path under a bright sky. The scene has a painterly style with soft blended forms and bold color blocking, overlaid with three horizontal white bars containing circular cutouts in the center like a graphic interface element.
